messages:
Tom (releases): Quick sync — RC1 targeting tomorrow 10:00 PT. Need internal blurb + release-note bullets + SLA wording for Dedicated. Docs/ops/marketing please chime in.
Megan (product): Copywise: two feature bullets + one known issue. I'll draft bullets now.
Emily (docs): Can you confirm RN structure? We usually have: Summary, Who's impacted, Migrations, Rollback steps.
Jordan (ops): Canary window 10:00–11:00 PT. Canary lanes: 5% then 30% at +20m if metrics stable. Rollback triggers: >3% error spike OR p50 latency >200ms sustained 5m.
Raj (eng): Also: pin runtime to v2.4.1-hotfix for Dedicated — otherwise clients may pick up v2.5. Any objections?
Megan (product): No objections. Add item: 'Pinned runtime v2.4.1-hotfix for Dedicated customers' in RN.
Lisa (marketing): Need a 1-paragraph internal blurb for #general + Ops. Keep it high level; I'll craft external later.
Emily (docs): Draft RN snippet to iterate on:
```
- Summary: RC1 adds request multiplexing and cost optimizations for batch workloads.
- Impact: Hosted API: no breaking changes. Dedicated: runtime pinned to v2.4.1-hotfix.
- Migration: none for hosted. Dedicated customers on custom runtimes should coordinate with SE.
- Rollback: Use deploybot rollback lane (see ops note).
```
Megan (product): Here's a short internal blurb — edit as needed:
'RC1 rollout tomorrow 10:00 PT. Key wins: multiplexing for batch jobs (10-40% token cost reduction), stability fixes for long-context sessions. Dedicated customers will be pinned to v2.4.1-hotfix — SEs notified. Canary 10:00–11:00 PT; rollback criteria in thread.'
Jordan (ops): Ops note to append to RN: `Canary progression: 5%->30%->100%. Monitors: error_rate, request_latency_p50, kv_cache_misses. Auto-fallback to v2.3.9 if persistent failures.`
Raj (eng): Quick config snippet for ops playbook:
```
deploybot canary --model rc1 --lanes=5,30,100 --watch=error_rate>0.03:5m,latency_p50>200ms:5m
```
ops-runner: Added the above to the runbook and tagged SEs for Dedicated outreach: @se-queue.
deploy-bot: preflight checks queued by Tom (releases)...
deploy-bot: preflight result: OK — image checksum verified, smoke tests passed (8/8), infra quotas ok. :white_check_mark: 
Lisa (marketing): OK to use Megan's blurb for internal channels. I'll truncate for #general and add link to RN doc.
Megan (product): Emily — can you drop the RN into /docs/releases/rc1-digest.md and link from the blurb?
Emily (docs): On it. I'll include the bullet list and ops note. Ping me for copy edits after 08:00 PT.
Tom (releases): Thanks everyone. I'll kick off the dry run at 08:30 PT. deploy-bot, please run a canary dry-run and post results here.
deploy-bot: dry-run started by Tom (releases) — lanes 5,30. Simulating traffic... 
deploy-bot: dry-run complete — no regressions observed. Canary simulation metrics look healthy. :thumbsup: 
Tom (releases): Perfect. Final ask: if anyone objects to the blurb or SLA wording, speak now. Otherwise I'll pin RN link and schedule internal announce at 09:30 PT.
Raj (eng): LGTM.
Jordan (ops): LGTM. I'll be on watch during canary.
Lisa (marketing): LGTM from comms.
Megan (product): LGTM. I'll send the SE heads-up immediately.
Tom (releases): Great — locking this down. Thanks. :rocket:
